$comment: Example configuration set for token-sink (issue #90). Everything here targets RFC 2606 reserved domains or local_fixture entries ONLY. NEVER run against real targets.

files.config.example.yaml: Full application config (PLAN section 16) - copy to tokensink.yaml and adjust.
files.campaign.example.json: Example campaign record exercising every PLAN section 5 field, validated against schemas/campaign.schema.json by tests/unit/test_examples.py.
files.scope-policy.example.json: Allowlist-only scope policy with SSRF-relevant restrictions (local_fixture + reserved domains), matching the example campaign UUID.
files.providers/gateway-with-filter.example.js: Provider config, gateway class with free_model_filter_required=true (PLAN sections 8.1/7.3).
files.providers/custom-endpoint.example.json: Provider config, custom_endpoint class (self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server).

credential_safety.rule: Credentials are NEVER literal values. Config files reference ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE NAMES (auth_ref); for dry runs export fake placeholders such as sk-example-0000000000000000000000.

golden_rule: These examples exist so new users and CI can validate structure offline. Do not point any tooling at real infrastructure using these files.
